one_line: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO amid investigations and market drops, while Anthropic drew massive IPO demand and Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen.

themes.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
themes.text: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang stepped down following reports of extramarital affairs, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO. Nvidia shares fell significantly, erasing over $600 billion in market value.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
Nvidia employees stunned as board weighs Jensen Huang’s future after affair disclosures
Nvidia shares fall 14% after CEO Jensen Huang resigns, market cap slips below $4 trillion
Nvidia board and interim CEO address staff after CEO resignation

themes.title: U.S. probes Nvidia amid export inquiries
themes.text: The U.S. Justice Department and congressional committees opened antitrust and national security probes into Nvidia, examining China chip sales and export controls. Former CEO Jensen Huang agreed to testify before Congress.

stories.headline: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress by Thanksgiving
US DOJ opens antitrust and related probes involving Nvidia
Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling
Democrats launch Nvidia investigation into China chip sales and Trump deal
Senate Banking Chair Tim Scott asks Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick to testify
US officials disagree on whether Alice Huang spied for China
Firms linked to Alice Huang invest $14 million in DeepSeek and promise Nvidia Blackwell chips

themes.title: Anthropic IPO draws heavy demand
themes.text: Anthropic's IPO is six times oversubscribed as the company targets a $1.4 trillion valuation. Meanwhile, Nvidia-backed cloud provider Nscale needs additional financing following a $45 billion Anthropic chip order.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO draws about six times the orders for available shares
Nscale says it needs extra funding for 2027 commitments after $45B Anthropic chip order

themes.title: New models and security tools launch
themes.text: Google DeepMind launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen for coding and search, while OpenAI released two Daybreak security products for vulnerability testing. Additionally, LangChain raised $300 million at a $3 billion valuation.

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for everyday coding and search
OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security products
LangChain raises $300 million, valuation climbs to $3 billion
